body_plan: legless serpent, upright S-curve neck, tail coiled flat on the ground
notes: body_chain runs from the bottom of the S (where neck meets the ground coil) up to the head base; tail runs from that same base point around the flat coil (passes along -X side, behind, ending on the +X side). The coil rests ON the ground and must stay on it (it is the support - root/pelvis is the coil base). Locomotion = slither: travelling S-wave down the tail coil (yaw) + gentle neck sway; neck/head bob like a sea serpent. Frill/crest around the head and down the back of the upper neck: rigid to head/upper neck bones (or 1 soft bone). Side fins: one bone each, small flutter. Attack = neck rears back then strikes forward (bite, jaw opens). Cast = rises tall, frill flares, head up. KO = neck collapses forward/sideways onto the coil, head resting on the ground. Nothing below Z=0.
